title: Runtime configuration
description: The visual form and YAML editor use the same configuration, validation, and fingerprint-based compare-and-swap.
secretWarningDescription: Do not screenshot it or share it with unauthorized people. A configuration is not applied when its database probe fails.
lastError: The most recent hot reload failed; the last valid configuration remains active:
conflict: Another window or file editor changed the configuration. Reload it and merge your changes.
externalEditHint: External edits are still validated and hot-reloaded automatically. A database driver change takes effect after the supervisor restarts the process.

actions.generateFor: Generate a new random secret for {label}

errors.notObject: The top level of the configuration must be a mapping
errors.yamlSwitch: Cannot switch to visual configuration yet: {reason}

success.driverRestart: a database driver change requires a restart

completed.label: Setup completed
completed.description: Maintained by the first-run wizard. Disabling it re-enables the setup gate.

baseUrl.label: Site base URL
baseUrl.description: Used for metadata and absolute links, for example https://mail.example.com.

trustProxyHeaders.label: Trust reverse-proxy headers
trustProxyHeaders.description: Enable only behind a controlled Caddy or reverse proxy.

autoRestartOnDriverChange.label: Exit automatically on driver change
autoRestartOnDriverChange.description: In production, Docker or systemd starts the replacement process.

emailPollIntervalMs.label: Mailbox polling interval (ms)
emailPollIntervalMs.description: How often browsers refresh message lists.

driver.label: Database driver
driver.description: A cross-driver switch validates the target database and requires a process restart.

path.label: SQLite file
path.description: Must be inside the data/ directory.

backupDir.label: SQLite backup directory
backupDir.description: Must be inside data/ and must not conflict with database sidecar files.

backupRetentionDays.label: SQLite backup retention (days)
backupRetentionDays.description: Maintenance removes only archives with a strict configuration pair.

url.label: PostgreSQL URL
url.description: Query parameters are forbidden. Credentials are stored in the local mode-0600 configuration.

poolMax.label: Maximum pool size
poolMax.description: Maximum database connections used by the Web process.

idleTimeoutMs.label: Idle connection timeout (ms)
idleTimeoutMs.description: How long the pool retains an idle connection.

connectTimeoutMs.label: Connection timeout (ms)
connectTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for configuration probes and runtime connections.

ssl.label: Enable PostgreSQL TLS
ssl.description: Applied consistently to the Web app and maintenance tools.

sslRejectUnauthorized.label: Strict certificate verification
sslRejectUnauthorized.description: Recommended for an external production PostgreSQL server.

backupRetentionDays.label: PostgreSQL backup retention (days)
backupRetentionDays.description: Shared by the Node and tools-container maintenance paths.

secret.label: Session signing secret
secret.description: Required after setup. Regenerating it invalidates existing sign-in sessions.

passwordPepper.label: Password pepper
passwordPepper.description: Required after setup and cannot be rotated directly without invalidating existing passwords.

emperorBootstrapSecret.label: Emperor bootstrap secret
emperorBootstrapSecret.description: Used by the compatibility promotion endpoint. Empty disables it; use a random value when enabled.

clientId.label: GitHub Client ID
clientId.description: Configure together with the client secret.

clientId.label: Google Client ID
clientId.description: Configure together with the client secret.

windowSeconds.label: Rate-limit window (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: Counting window for sign-in and registration attempts.

maxClients.label: Rate-limit client capacity
maxClients.description: Maximum clients retained in the in-memory limiter.

ingestSecret.label: Worker ingest secret
ingestSecret.description: Required after setup. After regeneration, update the Cloudflare Worker Secret to match.

batchSize.label: Cleanup batch size
batchSize.description: Rows processed in each delete loop.

maxRows.label: Maximum rows per cleanup
maxRows.description: Prevents a maintenance task from running for too long.

lockStaleMinutes.label: Cleanup lock age (minutes)
lockStaleMinutes.description: Used only to determine whether a maintenance lock is abandoned.

permanentMessageRetentionDays.label: Permanent-mailbox retention (days)
permanentMessageRetentionDays.description: 0 keeps messages in permanent mailboxes regardless of age.

cleanupIntervalSeconds.label: Cleanup interval (seconds)
cleanupIntervalSeconds.description: Read dynamically by the scheduler profile.

backupIntervalSeconds.label: Backup interval (seconds)
backupIntervalSeconds.description: Read dynamically by the scheduler profile.

backupOnStart.label: Back up on startup
backupOnStart.description: Create a recovery point when the scheduler starts.

intervalSeconds.label: Monitoring interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: Check interval for the monitoring profile.

healthcheckUrl.label: Health-check URL
healthcheckUrl.description: Empty uses the current service's default endpoint.

diskPath.label: Disk monitoring path
diskPath.description: Empty selects the default data path for the active database driver.

accessLog.label: Access log path
accessLog.description: Optional source for HTTP 5xx and ingest-failure counts.

minFreePercent.label: Minimum free space (percent)
minFreePercent.description: Alert below this threshold; 0 disables it.

minFreeGb.label: Minimum free space (GiB)
minFreeGb.description: Alert below this threshold; 0 disables it.

maxWalMb.label: Maximum WAL size (MiB)
maxWalMb.description: Alert above this threshold; 0 disables it.

maxPostgresDatabaseGb.label: Maximum PostgreSQL database size (GiB)
maxPostgresDatabaseGb.description: Alert above this threshold; 0 disables it.

windowMinutes.label: Log analysis window (minutes)
windowMinutes.description: Counting window for HTTP and ingest failures.

maxHttp5xx.label: Maximum HTTP 5xx per window
maxHttp5xx.description: Alert above this count; 0 disables it.

maxIngestFailures.label: Maximum ingest failures per window
maxIngestFailures.description: Alert above this count; 0 disables it.

remote.label: Rclone remote
remote.description: For example remote:moemail. Empty disables offsite synchronization.

intervalSeconds.label: Offsite sync interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: Read dynamically by the offsite profile.

rcloneConfigContent.label: Rclone configuration content
rcloneConfigContent.description: Complete sensitive configuration written to a private temporary file at runtime.
